title: shadcn dashboard
intent: Reproduce shadcn/ui's canonical dashboard shell and interactive stacked-area card while replacing only Recharts with TanStack Charts.

ai.create: Reproduce the official shadcn/ui dashboard-01 layout and data. Keep the dashboard shell independent of the chart renderer, then implement its filtered, stacked, gradient area chart with TanStack Charts.
ai.maintain: Preserve the official dashboard data, responsive sidebar, metric cards, time-range behavior, table shell, natural stacked-area geometry, gradients, axis labels, tooltip content, light and dark themes, and a renderer-only compact catalog preview.
